lesson: Set default MAX_ATTEMPTS in retryx/retry.py to 7. Initial values of 10 and 5 were rejected because 10 caused 429 rate limit errors and 5 unnecessarily left retries on the table.
why: Empirical measurements showed 7 attempts (12.7s cumulative delay) fit just under the upstream rate-limit reset window, whereas an 8th attempt (25.5s) exceeds the window and gets blocked.
